filters.description: Windows 365 Cloud PCs. Used to target the Windows 365 baseline.
Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop and other virtual machines. Used to keep hardware-dependent policies off virtual devices.

filterAssignments.reason: BitLocker is not supported on Cloud PCs or AVD
Cloud PCs use the Windows 365 Device Health compliance policy

removeSettings.reason: Blocking NTLM breaks shares, printers and apps reached by IP address or without a Kerberos SPN, and NTLMv1-only devices.
A minimum SMB version of 3.1.1 blocks file servers and domain controllers on Windows Server 2012 R2 or older, including SYSVOL and NETLOGON.

removeSettings.policy: * - Device Security - D - Local Security Policies - *
removeSettings.reason: NTLMv2-only, required SMB signing and restricted remote SAM calls break older SMB servers, NTLMv1 devices and remote inventory tools.

removeSettings.policy: * - Local Group Membership - D - Local Administrators - *
removeSettings.reason: Replaces the local Administrators group, removing Domain Admins and groups added by Group Policy.
Limits network access to Administrators and blocks local accounts from network and RDP logon, cutting off domain users and remote admin tools.

removeSettings.policy: * - Device Security - U - Device Guard, Credential Guard and HVCI - *
removeSettings.reason: Credential Guard and LSA protection with UEFI lock break PEAP-MSCHAPv2 Wi-Fi and VPN, NTLMv1, unconstrained delegation and third-party LSA plugins, and are hard to undo.

skipByDefault.reason: Sets the same rules as ASR Rules (Audit Mode). Deploy it after auditing, in place of the audit policy.
Conflicts with Automatic Restart Sign-On and needs Windows Enterprise.
